study_region.grid: square cells in EPSG:3310 NAD83/California Albers

prediction.target: >=1 FPA-FOD discovery in cell during [issue, issue+6]

fire_occurrence.name: USFS Fire Program Analysis Fire-Occurrence Database (FPA-FOD), 7th edition
fire_occurrence.query_where: fire_year >= 2014 AND fire_year <= 2024 AND latitude >= 38.83175 AND latitude <= 41.21527 AND longitude >= -123.02567 AND longitude <= -120.52720
fire_occurrence.date_convention: discovery_date is an ArcGIS Date (epoch ms). Its UTC calendar date matched discovery_doy for every record, so it is used as a local calendar date with no timezone conversion.

weather.name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis, ERA5 / ERA5-Land family)
weather.sampling: one point per 2x2 block of 25 km EPSG:3310 cells, at block centroid
weather.limitation: Reanalysis is not the forecast available on the issue date; 7-day lag applied.

missing_data_policy: Fire records with missing date or invalid coordinates are dropped (none found). Weather features require complete trailing windows; rows lacking them would stop training rather than be imputed (none occurred). No values are simulated.
cost: All sources are free public endpoints; no paid API, plan or compute used.
